title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: settlement before the annual aggregate, by liability measure
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes which figure stands as the settlement, before any annual aggregate, according to the liability measure of the cover's product.

## Rule

| Liability measure of the product | Settlement before any annual aggregate |
|---|---|
| Hague-Visby limitation | The proven loss, but no more than the Hague-Visby limit: the lower of the two |
| Declared value | The proven loss, but no more than the declared value share: the lower of the two |
| CargoCare cover | The CargoCare amount: the proven loss after the valuation uplift, the one applicable deductible and the per-container cap |

The measure is read from the product of the cover; it is never chosen for the claim.

## Hypothetical worked examples

All figures are hypothetical.

- Under Hague-Visby limitation, a proven loss of 7,000.00 USD against a Hague-Visby limit of 4,800.00 USD stands at 4,800.00 USD.
- Under declared value, a proven loss of 7,000.00 USD against a declared value share of 9,000.00 USD stands at 7,000.00 USD.
- Under CargoCare cover, the Hague-Visby limit and the declared value share play no part; the CargoCare amount stands.

## Wrong reading and correct reading

- *Wrong reading:* apply the Hague-Visby limit to every claim as a floor or ceiling. *Correct reading:* the Hague-Visby limit applies only under the Hague-Visby limitation measure.
